title.en: Where to Stay for a Clay-Court Trip in Paris

excerpt.en: Five hotels within 20 minutes of the best public clay courts in Paris.
excerpt.zh: 距离巴黎最佳公共红土球场 20 分钟内的五家酒店。

affiliateNote.zh: 预订链接为联盟推广链接。

note.en: 12-min walk to Stade Suzanne Lenglen, racket storage room
note.zh: 步行 12 分钟到 Suzanne Lenglen 球场，有球拍寄存

note.en: Near Roland Garros, run by a former tour coach
note.zh: 罗兰加洛斯附近，老板是前职业教练

note.en: Dorm beds from €28 with free court booking help
note.zh: 床位 €28 起，免费帮订球场

body.en:
Paris is the spiritual home of clay-court tennis. Our top pick: Hotel Court Central — a 12-minute walk from Stade Suzanne Lenglen's public courts, with a racket storage room and late breakfast for morning players. Mid-range: Les Terrabattes B&B near Roland Garros, run by a former tour coach. Budget: Courtside Hostel, dorm beds from €28 with free court booking help.

When to go: May for the French Open atmosphere (book 4+ months ahead), September for empty courts and soft light.

Getting there: Most hotels are on Metro Line 9 or the T2 tram; a Navigo weekly pass covers everything.
body.zh:
巴黎是红土网球的精神故乡。首推：Central Court 酒店——步行 12 分钟到 Suzanne Lenglen 体育场公共球场，有球拍寄存室，还为晨练球友提供延迟早餐。中档：罗兰加洛斯附近的 Les Terrabattes 民宿，老板是前职业教练。经济型：Courtside 青旅，床位 28 欧起，还免费帮你订球场。

最佳时间：5 月感受法网氛围（需提前 4 个月以上预订），9 月球场人少、光线柔和。

交通：多数酒店在地铁 9 号线或 T2 有轨电车沿线，周票 Navigo 全覆盖。

title.en: A Tennis Academy Week in Mallorca
title.zh: 马略卡网球学院一周记

excerpt.en: Train in the morning, swim in the afternoon — hotels and academies combined.
excerpt.zh: 上午训练，下午下海——学院与酒店 combo 攻略。

note.zh: 屋顶泳池，高蛋白外带早餐

note.en: Country finca 10 min from the academies
note.zh: 乡村民宿，距学院 10 分钟

note.en: Seafront budget stay near the harbor courts
note.zh: 海边经济型住宿，靠近港口球场

body.en:
Mallorca has quietly become Europe's best value tennis destination. Combine a 5-morning intensive package (€240) at one of the island's academies with a sea-view hotel in Palma. Our hotel pick: Playa Azul — 15 minutes from the academy, rooftop pool, and they'll pack you a protein-heavy to-go breakfast.

Off-court: Cala beaches are 20 minutes by bus; the old town is perfect for rest days.

Budget breakdown: flights €120 return (EU), hotel €65/night double, academy €240, court time often included.
body.zh:
马略卡悄悄成了欧洲性价比最高的网球目的地。把 5 个上午的集训套餐（240 欧）和帕尔马海景酒店组合起来。酒店推荐：Playa Azul——离学院 15 分钟，屋顶泳池，还会给你打包高蛋白外带早餐。

场外活动：Cala 海滩公交 20 分钟，老城适合休息日闲逛。

预算参考：机票往返 120 欧（欧盟内），酒店 65 欧/晚（双人间），学院 240 欧，场地费通常已含。

excerpt.en: Morning clay sessions, afternoon surf breaks — the ultimate tennis crossover trip.
excerpt.zh: 上午打红土，下午冲浪——网球跨界度假天花板。

note.en: Private hard court surrounded by rice paddies
note.zh: 稻田环绕的私人硬地球场

body.en:
Bali is the ultimate tennis crossover destination. Start with a morning session on red clay at Uluwatu Clay Resort — their on-site pro runs a 90-minute drill from 7am before the heat kicks in. Afternoon: 10-minute drive to the beach for surf. The resort's ocean-view courts are among the most photogenic in Asia.

For budget travelers, Canggu Surf & Stay puts you within biking distance of both beach breaks and the local clay courts. Ubud Tennis Villa is the zen option — a private hard court surrounded by rice paddies, perfect for mindful practice.

Best season: April–October (dry season). Book the resort's clay court at sunrise slots — the light is unreal and the courts are freshly watered.
body.zh:
巴厘岛是网球跨界度假的天花板。早上在 Uluwatu Clay Resort 的红土球场训练——驻场教练 7 点开 90 分钟 drills，趁凉快把活干完。下午：开车 10 分钟去冲浪。这家度假村的海景球场是亚洲最出片的球场之一。

预算玩家选 Canggu Surf & Stay，骑车就能到浪点和红土球场。想禅修选 Ubud Tennis Villa——稻田环绕的私人硬地球场，适合静心练球。

最佳季节：4-10 月（旱季）。订度假村日出时段红土场——光线绝美，场地刚浇过水。

body.en:
Shanghai has quietly built one of Asia's densest networks of public clay courts. Our favorite cluster: the Xuhui Riverside courts — three red clay surfaces maintained to near-tour standard, open until 10pm on weekdays. For indoor play, the Pudong Tennis Center has eight hard courts under air conditioning.

Pair your court time with the Riverside Tennis Hotel — a 5-minute walk to the clay, with a rooftop warm-up area and racket stringing service on-site. Budget travelers love the Pudong Players Hostel: dorm beds from ¥150 with free indoor court access included.

Pro tip: book clay courts via the city's public sports app 2-3 days ahead on weekends; weekday evenings are walk-in friendly.
body.zh:
上海悄悄建起了亚洲最密集的公共红土球场网络。最爱的集群：徐汇滨江球场——三片接近巡回赛标准的红土场，工作日开到晚 10 点。室内打球去浦东网球中心，八片空调硬地球场。

搭配 Riverside Tennis Hotel 住——步行 5 分钟到红土场，楼顶有热身区，驻场穿线服务。预算玩家爱 Pudong Players Hostel：床位 ¥150 起，含免费室内球场。

小贴士：周末红土场通过市公共体育 App 提前 2-3 天订；工作日晚场可直接 walk-in。
